sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /data /data/source_a /data/source_b /data/source_c /app 2>&1
echo "---PYTHON---"
python3 -c "import pandas, pyarrow; print(pandas.__version__, pyarrow.__version__)" 2>&1
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
echo "=== source_a JSON ==="; cat /data/source_a/users.json
echo; echo "=== source_b CSV ==="; cat /data/source_b/users.csv
echo; echo "=== source_c PARQUET ==="
python3 <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_parquet('/data/source_c/users.parquet')
print(df.to_string())
print("\n--- dtypes ---")
print(df.dtypes)
print("\n--- schema ---")
print(df.dtypes)
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /workspace
find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -100
echo "--- root tests ---"
find / -maxdepth 3 -iname '*test*' 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E '^/(usr|proc|sys|opt|lib|lib64|etc|var)' | head -50
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la / /root /tmp 2>/dev/null
find / -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*task*' -o -iname '*instruction*' -o -iname '*spec*' -o -iname '*.md' \) 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E '^/(usr|proc|sys|opt|lib|lib64|etc|var)' | head -50
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
pwd
ls -la /workspace
find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -ls
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app && python3 merge_users.py
echo "=== merged parquet ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print(df.to_string())
print(df.dtypes)
PY
echo "=== conflicts.json ==="
cat /app/conflicts.json
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, pyarrow.parquet as pq
for dtype in ['object', 'string']:
    df = pd.DataFrame({'user_id':[1], 'name':['A']})
    if dtype == 'string':
        df['name'] = df['name'].astype('string')
    df.to_parquet(f'/tmp/{dtype}.parquet', index=False)
    back = pd.read_parquet(f'/tmp/{dtype}.parquet')
    print(dtype, back.dtypes.to_dict(), type(back['name'].iloc[0]))
    print(pq.read_schema(f'/tmp/{dtype}.parquet'))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
from pandas.api.types import is_string_dtype
s_obj = pd.Series(['a','b'], dtype=object)
s_str = pd.Series(['a','b'], dtype='string')
print('obj:', is_string_dtype(s_obj), s_obj.dtype)
print('str:', is_string_dtype(s_str), s_str.dtype)
print('obj with None:', is_string_dtype(pd.Series(['a', None], dtype=object)))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/app/merge_users.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('        merged[column] = merged[column].astype("string")',
              '        merged[column] = merged[column].astype(object)')
p.write_text(s)
PY
cd /app && python3 merge_users.py
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print(df.to_string())
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.to_dict(orient='records'))
PY
cat /app/conflicts.json
EOF
